entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Garuda Indonesian Airways Flight 150 was a scheduled Indonesian domestic passenger flight from Kemayoran Airport, Jakarta to Sultan Mahmud Badaruddin II Airport, Palembang. On 24 September 1975, Flight 150 crashed on approach due to poor weather and fog just 2.5 miles from the town of Palembang. The accident killed 25 out of the 61 passengers and crew on board, and one person on the ground.
